headline: US-Israel War On Iran Triggers Global Energy Crisis, Forcing Geopolitical Shifts and Supply Chain Disruptions
summary: An escalating US-Israel war with Iran has unleashed the biggest global energy crisis since the 1970s, prompting nations like Germany to fundamentally rethink their energy strategies and exposing the fragility of global energy systems. This conflict will profoundly impact global geopolitics, severely disrupt critical energy and logistics supply chains, and drive up manufacturing and operational costs across all sectors, including the tech industry.
